subject.title: fix(security): bind GCP deletion to exact claims

question: Should direct GCP cleanup and release keep the new fail-closed exact-claim contract for legacy or claimless resources once the final delete identity binding is fixed?
rationale: This is a security-boundary repair, but it intentionally stops label-only direct GCP cleanup/release workflows that previously worked after local state was missing or stale.

options.title: Keep fail-closed exact claims
options.body: Require exact local GCP claims for destructive release and cleanup, and document manual operator cleanup for claimless resources.

options.title: Preserve label-only compatibility
options.body: Avoid breaking legacy cleanup/release behavior, but accept that mutable GCP labels remain destructive authority.

options.title: Narrow to cleanup first
options.body: Guard bulk cleanup now and split ReleaseLease compatibility into a separate maintainer decision.

recommendation.title: Keep fail-closed exact claims
recommendation.body: Require exact local GCP claims for destructive release and cleanup, and document manual operator cleanup for claimless resources.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns most of the current GCP provider history and recent cloud cleanup hardening context.
